tools_helpful.evidence: Scaffolded the WinUI 3 project, preserved UWP source under .uwp-source/, and mass-rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml; build reached only a handful of residual errors.

tool_limitations.limitation: Namespace mass-replace only rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml; it leaves Windows.UI.Colors / Windows.UI.ColorHelper untouched, so any file using SolidColorBrush(Colors.X) still fails with CS0234.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Also rewrite the Windows.UI.Colors and Windows.UI.ColorHelper tokens (which moved to Microsoft.UI) while leaving the Windows.UI.Color struct and non-moved Windows.UI.* namespaces alone.

failed_apis.root_cause: Colors moved from Windows.UI to Microsoft.UI in WinUI 3; the automated rewrite only covered Windows.UI.Xaml

special_apis.special_handling: Type name collides with the project's root namespace (Altimeter). Requires either a neutral root namespace or a `using AltimeterSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Altimeter;` alias.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Colors/ColorHelper moved to Microsoft.UI; automated rewrite only handled Windows.UI.Xaml

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'Altimeter' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project root namespace equals a WinRT type name (Altimeter), so the namespace shadows Windows.Devices.Sensors.Altimeter
errors_encountered.fix: Rename root namespace to the UWP source's neutral namespace (SDKTemplate) or alias the WinRT type

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist in the current context
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold-generated App/MainWindow kept namespace 'Altimeter' while copied pages used 'SDKTemplate'; the pages could not see App
errors_encountered.fix: Unify every file onto one root namespace (SDKTemplate)

errors_encountered.root_cause: A botched multi-line file edit left an unbalanced brace / stray members outside the type
errors_encountered.fix: Re-emitted the file with correct structure (self-inflicted edit slip)

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0103 'App does not exist' + CS0118 'Altimeter is a namespace' across several files
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Mixed root namespaces (scaffold app-name 'Altimeter' vs UWP source 'SDKTemplate') plus app name colliding with a WinRT type
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Renamed pages to SDKTemplate and aliased the sensor type
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance to unify on the UWP source's original namespace and to watch for app-name/WinRT-type collisions

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Windows.UI.Colors not rewritten by the bootstrap
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Extending the Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 rewrite to Colors/ColorHelper

env_issues.issue: No altimeter sensor on the CI machine
env_issues.workaround: App shows its 'No altimeter found' fallback; behavior is hardware-gated and unverifiable on both UWP and WinUI. Not a migration defect.
